Theme

Latin word

societās

societās, societātis f.

noun, third declension

a company, a partnership; partnership, cooperation, joint undertaking; a league, an alliance; a partnership; an association formed for a common purpose; a company; society, fellowship, partnership; society: the fellowship of people living together

In this lexicon

  • company

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sest. 32: nūlla Rōmae societās vectīgālium (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. corporation, company; Traupman 333

  • cooperation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Phil. 2.24: societātem cum aliquō coīre (Lewis & Short); Phaedr. 1.5.1

  • league

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 6.2: Ambiorīgem sibi societāte et foedere adjungunt (Lewis & Short); Sall. J. 77.2: amīcitiam societātemque

  • organization

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sest. 32: nūlla Rōmae societās vectīgālium, nūllum conlēgium aut concilium; Cic. Planc. 32: maximārum societātum auctor

  • social

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.54: prīma societās in ipsō conjugiō est; Cic. Amic. 20: societās generis hūmānī (Lewis & Short)

  • society

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.53: gradūs autem plūrēs sunt societātis hominum; Cic. Amic. 20: societās generis hūmānī (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. society: societās hūmāna
